# Jielong (接龙)

> Jielong (新接龙 — 新西兰社群，就用新接龙) is a batch commerce platform for New Zealand merchants: publish a time-boxed group-buy campaign, collect demand from shoppers, then produce and fulfil every order together as one batch.

Jielong is built for the model where a merchant opens a recurring ordering window (a "接龙"), shoppers commit and pay upfront within that window, and only once it closes does the merchant know the full picture — so they cook or pack once, for everyone, instead of fulfilling one order at a time. This is different from generic pre-order/pickup tools, which take orders continuously and expect on-demand fulfilment.

## How it works

1. Merchant publishes a campaign: title, rich-text details with images, a product catalog, an order deadline, and pickup points and/or delivery zones, each with their own time windows. Bundles (gift boxes with flavour choice or blind boxes), stacking discounts and Xiaohongshu promos are supported.
2. Merchant shares one link and an auto-generated QR code — commonly posted directly into a WeChat group. Shoppers tap the link or scan the code and land straight on the ordering page, no app install or account creation required to browse.
3. Shoppers select products, choose pickup or delivery, and pay upfront by direct bank transfer, uploading a screenshot as proof; the merchant confirms payment (or marks it paid) in the order list. Online EFTPOS — approving the payment in the shopper's own banking app, with automatic confirmation — is available to merchants on application.
4. When the window closes, the merchant sees every order rolled up into a per-product and per-pickup-point production summary (printable, CSV-exportable), so quantities to cook or pack are known in advance. An ended 接龙 can be reopened within 2 days for late orders.
5. Orders are handed out at the chosen pickup point and time window, or delivered; shoppers receive SMS notifications on arrival.

## Who it's for

New Zealand merchants running recurring group-buy campaigns, particularly home kitchens and small food businesses serving the Chinese community, who currently coordinate orders manually inside WeChat groups.

## Pricing

Free Starter tier for a small number of campaigns per month; paid Growth and Pro tiers unlock unlimited campaigns, multiple pickup points, delivery orders, and reporting. See https://jielong.co.nz/pricing

## Maker

Jielong is a product of GZhu Limited, a digital transformation partner based in Auckland, New Zealand. https://www.gzhu.co.nz
